frog_shg_1030nm.npz.what: SHG-FROG trace (rows: delay_s, columns: omega_rad_s of the SH signal), 1 % multiplicative + 1e-3 additive noise
frog_shg_1030nm.npz.expect: epie (300 iterations) or pcgpa (--iterations 1500 at this noise level): FROG error < 1e-3, FWHM within 5 %, |GDD| of the retrieved spectral phase within 5 % (its sign is ambiguous in SHG-FROG; the weak TOD is not recovered)

dscan_800nm.npz.what: SHG d-scan vs fused-silica insertion (+ dscan_800nm_fundamental.csv, the fundamental spectrum)
dscan_800nm.npz.expect: dscan: FWHM 30 fs (the chirped input), GDD of the retrieved phase -150 fs^2 within 10 %, with its sign

crosscorrelation_1030nm.csv.what: third-order cross-correlation (normalised signal vs delay), 100 dB dynamic range with detector noise
crosscorrelation_1030nm.csv.expect: pre-pulse near -65 dB at -20 ps, post-pulse near -40 dB at +35 ps, and the correlator's artefact of the post-pulse (~ -80 dB) at -35 ps; exponential wings of the pedestal

spm_spectrum.csv.what: spectrum after a 6.35 mm fused-silica plate (w0 = 120 um at its centre), 250 fs TL input at 1030 nm; with spm_autocorrelation.csv. The pulse energy is the unknown.
spm_spectrum.csv.expect: a fit of pulse/energyJ (fitting plugin, docs/plugins/fitting.md) finds 6 uJ within ~5 %
